content.comment_body: Hello experts, I am working with [product_name] [article_no] and have added an expansion module [article_no] to it. I have already configured the base [product_name] in [product_name] software. My question is: where do I configure the expansion module [article_no] in [product_name] software? This is urgent.
[user_name], sorry for the typo earlier. I am actually using [article_no] [product_name].

Thank you for your reply, [user_name]. Your explanation really helped me. I appreciate your support.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unsure about how to set up an expansion module for a [product_name] using [product_name] software.
